artifacts.notes: Extent as the retrieving lane measured it: Complete uncorrected OCR of Missale Romanum, Tournai: Desclee, 1889 (Leo XIII recognitum) — a commercial edition, not a typical one. Whole volume; no page image consulted. Uncorrected optical recognition: a locating and searching layer, not a text of record. No page image of this book was consulted by the retrieving lane, so nothing taken from it rises above an uncollated optical reading.
artifacts.rights_basis: The printing reproduced here was published before 1931 and is in the public domain in the United States: the repository's own rights reading, recorded at guidance/missals.md section 5 against Cornell's public-domain chart current at 1 January 2026, is that a work first published abroad before 1931 is in the public domain with no term running. The Internet Archive's optical character recognition of a public-domain printing is a mechanical transcription that adds no original authorship, is served without a copyright claim asserted over it, and carries none of the host's markup, navigation or apparatus. The bytes are retained here because guidance/sources.md makes retention the project-wide default and none of its three exemptions reaches this file: it may lawfully be republished, it is not restricted, and at 2.85 MB it is below the 5.88 MB that is the largest payload this library already retains.

edition.authority: Approbation of the ordinary of Tournai given at Tournai on 19 April 1889, reciting that the edition agrees with the Roman archetypes and that the book is 'Leonis XIII auctoritate recognitum'; all four facts are read in the registered text layer at its lines 70-84.

work.description: The Roman Rite altar book containing the Order of Mass, the temporal and sanctoral cycles, Commons, votive and Requiem Masses, and related rubrical and ritual material.
